description:
"Won't you marry me?" 

Haebom has lived confined behind high walls by the Songjeong Foods family. At the onset of spring, as winter was coming to an end, Haebom met Kang Ihan. 

"They say dimples are traces of God touching a face because it was too pretty."  
  
"He must have adored you very much."    

The man set to marry her sister. A man as unattainable as the moon, Kang Ihan. Yet, he keeps reaching out his hand to her. 

"Marry me for just one year. Then, Kanghan Electronics will be mine." 

A contract marriage with a set expiration date. Haebom knew that an even more hellish future awaited her after the contract with him ended. Even so, for the very first time in her life, she found something she desperately desired. 

"I want to marry you, Mr. Kang Ihan." 

Even if it's salvation that lasts only a year. She wants to experience the spring he offers, just for once.
